definition: An internal model, learned or engineered, that represents an AI system's understanding of how its environment behaves and changes in response to actions.
details: World models are central to planning-capable AI systems, including certain reinforcement learning agents, since a good internal simulation of environment dynamics allows an agent to evaluate potential actions before actually taking them.
